title: NClan
description: A lightweight, high-performance clans plugin that enhances community gameplay with robust management features, reliability, and full server-side configurability.
body:
![About](https://i.imgur.com/7paQx6L.png) # NClan NClan is a powerful and fully configurable clan system for modern Minecraft servers. Create clans, manage alliances, upgrade your clan, earn points through PvP, and communicate using private clan and alliance chats. Featuring multiple economy integrations, PlaceholderAPI support, GUI-based upgrades, anti-abuse protection, and Folia compatibility, NClan provides everything needed to build a competitive and engaging clan experience. --- ![Features](https://i.imgur.com/im3LuXp.png) ## Features - **Folia Support** – Compatible with Folia and supports modern Minecraft versions. - **100% Configurable** – Customize clan settings, tags, limits, points, chat formats, upgrades, and payment options. - **High Performance** – Designed to run smoothly without unnecessary overhead. - **Complete Clan Management** – Create clans, invite players, remove members, transfer ownership, and assign deputy roles. - **Alliances System** – Allow clans to build alliances with configurable alliance limits. - **Clan PvP Toggle** – Let clan leaders enable or disable friendly PvP between members. - **Points Progression** – Dynamic player and clan points system with configurable kill-based progression and per-clan boost multipliers. - **Kill Titles** – Show customizable kill and death titles directly to players on kill events. - **Clan & Alliance Chat** – Private chat channels for clan members (`!`) and allied clans (`!!`). - **Clan Upgrades** – GUI-based upgrade system to expand member slots, alliance slots, and boost kill points. - **Anti-Abuse System** – Configurable kill cooldown to prevent point farming from the same victim. - **Economy Integration** – Supports Vault, XP, PlayerPoints, CoinsEngine, and ItemStack. - **PlaceholderAPI Support** – 20+ placeholders including relational placeholders. - **Multi-Language** – Ships with 5 language files (English, Polish, German, Spanish, French). --- ![Commands](https://i.imgur.com/hnKPZe2.png) ## Player Commands | Command | Description | |----------|----------| | `/clan create ` | Creates a new clan | | `/clan delete` | Deletes your clan | | `/clan info [tag]` | Displays clan information | | `/clan join ` | Joins an invited clan | | `/clan leave` | Leaves your clan | | `/clan invite ` | Invites a player | | `/clan kick ` | Removes a player | | `/clan setowner ` | Transfers ownership | | `/clan deputy ` | Promotes deputy | | `/clan removedeputy ` | Removes deputy role | | `/clan alliance ` | Creates alliance | | `/clan removealliance ` | Removes alliance | | `/clan pvp` | Toggles clan PvP | | `/clan upgrades` | Opens upgrades GUI | ### Clan Chat | Prefix | Description | |----------|----------| | `!message` | Clan chat | | `!!message` | Alliance chat | ### Admin Commands | Command | Description | |----------|----------| | `/nclan reload` | Reload configuration | | `/nclan deleteclan ` | Delete clan | | `/nclan setleader ` | Set leader | | `/nclan join ` | Add player | | `/nclan kick ` | Remove player | | `/nclan setpoints ` | Set points | | `/nclan addpoints ` | Add points | | `/nclan removepoints ` | Remove points | | `/nclan setlimit ` | Set limits | | `/nclan setboost ` | Set boost | | `/nclan setupgrade ` | Set upgrade | | `/nclan economy set ` | Save ITEMSTACK currency | ### Player Info | Command | Description | |----------|----------| | `/player ` | Shows clan and points | --- ![Placeholders](https://i.imgur.com/JfyDrJh.png) ## Placeholders | Placeholder | Description | |----------|----------| | `%nclan_tag%` | Clan tag | | `%nclan_tag_upper%` | Clan tag uppercase | | `%nclan_tag_formatted%` | Formatted clan tag | | `%nclan_tag_formatted_%` | Relational formatted tag | | `%nclan_player_has_clan%` | Has clan | | `%nclan_player_points%` | Player points | | `%nclan_player_points_formatted%` | Formatted points | | `%nclan_clan_points%` | Clan points | | `%nclan_clan_members%` | Members count | | `%nclan_clan_members_online%` | Online members | | `%nclan_clan_pvp%` | PvP status | | `%nclan_clan_pvp_formatted%` | Formatted PvP status | | `%nclan_clan_max_members%` | Max members | | `%nclan_clan_free_slots%` | Free slots | | `%nclan_clan_can_invite%` | Can invite | | `%nclan_clan_can_join%` | Can join | | `%nclan_clan_is_owner%` | Is owner | | `%nclan_clan_is_deputy%` | Is deputy | | `%nclan_clan_upgrade_%` | Upgrade level | ### Relational Placeholders | Placeholder | Description | |----------|----------| | `%rel_nclan_tag%` | Target clan tag | | `%rel_nclan_tag_upper%` | Target clan tag uppercase | | `%rel_nclan_tag_formatted%` | Relation formatted clan tag | --- ![Configuration](https://i.imgur.com/RcqZKpU.png) ## Configuration Examples
config.yml ```yaml lang: en ... ``` ![Support](https://i.imgur.com/RcqZKpU.png)
upgrades.yml ```yaml upgrades: ... ```
messages.yml ```yaml messages: ... ```
